title: Smothered Cheesy Bean Burrito with Enchilada Sauce & Lime Crema

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat a large baking dish with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Coarsely grate cheese. Place half in a small bowl and set aside for burrito topping. (Reserve remaining cheese for the next step.)
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Transfer to a medium bowl along with the reserved cheese and spices; stir to combine the filling.

Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide filling down the center of each one. Roll tortillas tightly to close and transfer to the baking dish, seam-side down. (The burritos should not be touching.)
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until burritos are slightly crispy and heated through, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and mince onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion to the pan and cook, stirring often, until it begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add flour and spices to the pan with the onion; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.

Slowly whisk tomato sauce and broth into the pan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3-4 minutes. Remove enchilada sauce from heat, cover, and set aside.

Remove baking dish from the oven; pour enchilada sauce over the burritos and top with remaining cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until sauce is bubbly and cheese is melted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for the lime crema.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into the reserved bowl; add yogurt and salt. Whisk to combine the lime crema and set aside.
Stack lettuce leaves, one on top of the other; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Transfer to a large plate.
Small dice tomatoes. Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add both to the plate with the lettuce.
To serve, divide burritos and sauce between plates. Drizzle burritos with lime crema; top with lettuce, tomato, and green onions. Enjoy!
